description:
Portable USB rechargeable blender 380ml is the quick smoothie maker for gym mornings, office breaks, and travel days when you want fresh shakes without a full kitchen setup. Add cut fruit, milk or water, and your protein powder, then blend right in the cup for a single-serve drink you can carry anywhere. The 6‑blade stainless steel design helps mix soft fruits and light ingredients smoothly, so you get fewer lumps and a better texture.

This compact blender bottle is BPA‑free and made for daily use. The leak‑resistant lid and lightweight body make it backpack-friendly for tiffin breaks, picnics, and post-workout nutrition. Cleaning is simple—rinse soon after blending or do a quick “blend-and-rinse” with water and a drop of soap (keep the charging area dry). If you need an affordable personal blender that keeps your nutrition routine consistent, this 380ml USB blender is the grab-and-go solution.
